panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: CAM5.2 immunostain panel explicitly documents the papillomatous/hyperplastic epithelial proliferation of nipple adenoma at the superficial aspect (larger arrows). The same panel also contains deeper invasive carcinomatous elements (short arrow), so the panel is mixed, but the captioned NA manifestation is directly supported. B: p63 immunostain panel explicitly demonstrates the preserved (intact) myoepithelial cell layer around the ducts of nipple adenoma (larger arrows), a classic diagnostic feature of NA. The panel also shows loss of myoepithelium around invasive carcinoma (short arrow), i.e., mixed content, but the captioned NA finding is directly supported.
